entities.summary: Hittite Empire, a political institution in Türkiye during Ancient Anatolia and Hittite Empire (1700 BCE–1178 BCE). Grew from Çatalhöyük and Neolithic Anatolia and Çatalhöyük flourishes as a major Neolithic settlement of up to 10,000 people. Led to the emergence of Hittite Empire collapses in the Bronze Age Collapse and Phrygian.
